content.title: Chapter 62 - OFFENSES — Sec. 62-47. - Interference with police.
content.summary:
It shall be unlawful for any person intentionally to hinder, obstruct or otherwise
               interfere with any police officer acting under color of his official authority in
               the discharge or apparent discharge of his official duties.
(Code 1960, § 17-19; Code 1981, § 21-16)
